fundamentals.name: Alphabet Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.

judgment.summary: Alphabet demonstrates strong growth in revenue and earnings, coupled with excellent margins and a healthy balance sheet, despite a high valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter (Q1 2026) EPS beat estimates by 91.6% ($5.11 vs $2.67); next earnings date is 2026-07-23.
positives: Revenue growth 21.8% YoY and quarterly earnings growth 81.2% indicate robust top-line and bottom-line expansion.
Operating margin of 36.1% and profit margin of 37.9% showcase strong profitability.
Return on equity at 38.9% and return on assets at 14.6% reflect efficient capital utilization.
Significant free cash flow of $27.92B and substantial total cash of $126.84B provide financial flexibility.
Analyst consensus is 'strong_buy' with a mean target price significantly above the current spot price.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 28.13 and forward P/E of 25.49 suggest a premium valuation.
PEG ratio of 1.42 indicates that growth may not fully justify the current stock price.
Debt/Equity ratio of 20.03% is relatively low but warrants monitoring.
The stock has experienced a 4-week losing streak, testing investor appetite.

news.paragraph: Alphabet's stock is facing pressure this week, with reports indicating the company is seeking fresh capital amidst a four-week losing streak. While one analyst piece suggests AI capex is being managed well and the stock is underrated, other news highlights a dip related to a Google Cloud deal with Palantir and general market jitters. The stock's recent performance tests investor appetite, though the company's strong earnings growth and robust cash flow remain key fundamentals.
